correctness.rationale: For graphical zonotope normal fan of K_{2,m}, contracting equality edges yields connected ordered blocks and cones of dimension q-1. Primitive Hasse cover edges give a unimodular cone exactly for tree cover graphs. If centers comparable, minimal cover cycles are four-block A<i,j<B diamonds: two center order choices, choose i,j, assign other leaves to A or B, giving 2^{m-1}binom(m,2) 3-cones; transverse dual Hilbert basis gives uv-wz and star fan (P^1)^{m-2}. If centers incomparable, no leaf contracted, all m leaves independently above/below, giving 2^m full-dimensional minimal singular cones; dual semigroup e_i,e_i-e_s is 2xm rank-one Segre with multiplicity m. Independence of isolated points follows from smooth proper faces. Independently enumerated all weak-order sign cones and minimal singular cone dimensions: m=3 261 cones with 12 3-cones and 8 4-cones; m=4 1299 cones with 48 3-cones and 16 5-cones.
residual_risks: Finite m=3,4 runs corroborate minimal-face counts, but cannot certify all m or local semigroup rings; explicit lattice arguments are needed.
Toric variety is from the normal fan, not the affine edge ring; components are reduced support, not entire singular scheme.
